name: Lucy
desc:
An Edgerunner from the Night City. The Netrunner of her crew.
With a heavy debt in her heart, she deliberately keeps a distance from people. Even those who are closest to her know little of her past.

chara_info.talent_doc:
[██ Record Modification Log]

Modification Target: Lucy Kushinada
Modification Code: RA2██-G

The subject is identified as a Mutant-Type Resonator, with the Tacet Mark located on the right shoulder.

Forte Manifestation:
The subject can hack targets within a five-meter radius to achieve objectives such as information retrieval, data manipulation, or target control. Testing indicates this Forte can affect up to three targets simultaneously, with more pronounced effectiveness against mechanical constructs.

Bio-organic Hacking:
This Forte can also be used against Tacet Discords. After hacking a Tacet Discord, the subject can inflict damage or exert control by disrupting its frequency. The underlying mechanism and upper limits are currently unknown. The scope of control is speculated to be affected by the Resonator's own physical and emotional state. 

Under ███ guarantee, the Research Institute has agreed to limited ███ of the subject.

Cyberware Technology:
The subject exhibits multiple mechanical modifications grafted into her body. According to the subject's testimony, these modifications originate from ███ and are classified as cybernetic technology. Test results indicate this cyberware does not match any known existing technology, and this type of implant places significant strain on the user's body and psyche. On ██ ██, ███ intervened, canceling the research project on Night City technology.
chara_info.talent_certification: The subject's waveform diagram exhibits spike-type fluctuations with an unstable Time Domain, indicating abnormal fluctuation tendencies. Examination results indicate moderate risk factors. Conclusion: Resonant Criticality is low and subject stability is moderate. Potential risk of Overclocking. No history of Overclocking; however, based on clinical evaluation and diagnostic criteria, the subject exhibits psychological distress and stress responses. Routine psychological counseling is recommended. "Counseling recommendation has been rejected by the subject." "The subject previously used Forte to alter test results. Partial data has since been restored."

stories.title: Silhouettes Of the Past
stories.content:
Lucy keeps most of her past to herself for a reason. Few know that this mysterious netrunner was, in fact, shown the ropes by a top-secret Arasaka educational program for kids. One might say that's not the worst hand to be dealt; that a roof over your head and a full belly is more than many can hope for in Night City. But for Lucy, there was never any other path. She was brought up in this megacorp's black site—locked away and forced to train. Day after day, year after year, breaching the Blackwall, diving into the scattered depths of the Old Net. And trying to survive the rogue AIs that lurked there.
 
As a child, Lucy's worldview was built upon Arasaka's core pillar: obedience—often mistaken for loyalty. And she was not the only one taught to believe in it. A group of children took part in the program, either taken from their parents or scooped from the street. To serve the most powerful corporation on the planet—that was the dream Arasaka planted in their heads. Within that facility, they were forced to deep-dive the Old Net, running suicide gigs on repeat. None of them knew the perfect future they'd been promised was just a chimera. An elaborate fantasy spun by Arasaka handlers to serve the company's own ends. By the time Lucy figured out the truth, it was already too late.
 
The will to survive drove them to claw their way out of the prison they had long mistaken for home. They ran as fast as they could, bullets tearing through the air all around them. Gunfire and screams exploded in Lucy's ears, one after another. But she would survive. She squeezed her eyes shut, blocked everything out, and just kept running. The exit. She just had to reach the exit.
 
She woke up in some scrapyard with no memory of how she got there, and no idea if anyone else had made it out alive. She'd escaped the chase, for now, but the fear Arasaka had carved into her wasn't going anywhere. She knew they'd be hunting her. Could feel it under her skin. After that, she never stayed in one place for too long. Always moving. Always hiding.

stories.title: Dreams & the City of Dreams
stories.content:
It started with a poster: a man in a spacesuit, pointing the way to a better future. For Lucy, it was a promise of escape. And maybe, just maybe, finding a place so far away from danger that she could stay put. On countless nights, curled up with her arms wrapped around her knees, that dream took root. Planted by fear. Loneliness. A need for a place to call home.

"Maybe on the Moon, I'll finally be free?"

Cynics laughed at the idea, certain there was no corner safe from corporate dominance. To go there would be pointless; a propaganda-fuelled pipe dream. But these were the opinions of people who had never been to the Moon. So what did they know? Lucy would go there. See for herself. Someday.

Night City seemed like a good place to hide for a while. A concrete jungle. When she first arrived, she feared Arasaka's reach was too prominent, but soon she learned to haunt the corners of the city where corporations turned a blind eye. She realized that crime and violence were the true governors here. And with her skill set and caution, she was natural merc material. An edgerunner already long in the making. Her new home wasn't completely safe for her, but for the first time in years, she felt like she could survive.

Erasing every trace of her past became her new identity. To stay alive without blowing her cover, the former netrunner prodigy lived by a simple code: Stay low. Ask nothing. Tell less. Avoid Arasaka. That was her disguise. A small principle, but it was hers. Life only truly changed when Kiwi came looking for a preem netrunner to fill a slot in Maine's crew. She brought Lucy into the fold and gave her the most useful advice she'd ever get:

"Remember. Never trust a soul in Night City."

stories.title: When the Sandevistan Hits
stories.content:
One night, Lucy took David to her place and invited him to experience a braindance of the Moon. Since she couldn't afford to travel there yet, this was the closest she could get to the real deal. Feeling the sun on her face. Jumping and floating like a feather. Serenity. Without corpos, without gangers. It was the most precious part of herself she could share.

She couldn't deny that David piqued her interest. An Arasaka Academy dropout with the reckless ambition to become an edgerunner. Wielding extremely demanding—extremely dangerous—military-grade cyberware as if it were a toy. But he was a good kid, sincere, pure at heart. Someone she felt she could possibly trust. But Lucy had spent so long keeping the world at arm's length that she didn't know how to reach out.

After David joined Maine's crew, Lucy grumbled about being saddled with babysitting duty. But despite her protests, she took him under her wing. Became his first teacher on the streets of Night City. She showed him the ropes of a merc's day-to-day, assuming he wouldn't be cut out for the life. But as she watched the boy come into his own, the knot in her chest finally started to loosen.

Her certainty about him came the day he saved her life.

A routine night turned into a bloodbath. When Pilar fell, the crew shattered into a blur of instinct and rage. Hot-headed members like Rebecca threw themselves at the killer, while Lucy took cover to strike with caution. In the chaos, David froze. Unable to move, to fight, or even save himself. But through the mayhem, he was the only one to notice Lucy being cornered. That was all the motivation he needed. In an instant, he lunged into the fray, guns blazing. To save her.

Bang.

Smoke. Silence. A turning point for both of them.

After that, Lucy led him to the rooftop—the place where she'd always gone to look at the Moon. For the first time, she didn't go alone. She brought a boy who had nothing, who promised her everything.

He told her he'd take her there. To the Moon. Someday, somehow. A promise that burned brighter and felt more real than any neon in the city below.

So how could she not love him?

stories.title: My Moon My Man
stories.content:
Some say that tragedy is the only truth in Night City. That happiness is just fleeting smoke.

Maine and Dorio fell on a job gone sideways. David picked up the weight. Took over the crew. Maine's legacy. The life of an edgerunner. Rebecca switched to stronger cyber-arms and swore she'd never lose anyone else. Everyone moved forward.

Everyone, except Lucy.

She stepped back. Pulled away from the crew and secretly worked to protect David from the shadows, making sure Arasaka couldn't trace him. She told no one. Especially not him. She knew David would try to stop her, or worse, follow her into the fire. That was his nature. He was obsessed with protecting her. But for once, Lucy was determined to be the one holding the shield.

She was careful, but as it turned out, not careful enough. She'd underestimated Arasaka. Their fixer, Faraday, saw the opening. Found the crack in the armor. And in it, he discovered a way to exploit the love between two edgerunners to secure his ticket up the corpo ladder.

Having snatched Lucy, Faraday forced David into a desperate rescue mission as the boy teetered on the edge of cyberpsychosis. David didn't give up, not even with MaxTac hot on his heels. Rebecca and Falco—the remains of a loyal crew—threw themselves into the line of fire just to keep him moving.

The cyberskeleton did its job. David got Lucy out... only to fall into a trap set by Arasaka. A trap with Adam Smasher waiting inside.

David held Lucy close and jumped towards the Moon, which hung cold and white above the chaos. In that moment, her kiss pulled him back from the edge. Just long enough. Just enough for a final goodbye.

stories.title: So, Get Away
stories.content:
Rebecca and David were gone. Only Lucy and Falco survived that day. The two of them split ways after leaving Night City, and when the dust settled, it was time to move on again.
 
There was only one place she considered her destination. A too-obvious choice. A promise, never fulfilled. Did she go there to honor it, to make a dream come true, or to hide away for good? Lucy found herself on the Moon with no answers.
 
The real experience was different than the one from the braindance, and yet, the place had felt somehow familiar. For a moment, she could've sworn she saw David out of the corner of her eye. That was when the grief finally broke through. The Moon was still the same, but the boy who'd been beside her in the braindance wasn't there anymore.
 
Yet, maybe the story wasn't over.
 
"There… is a method. To let you stay."
 
On the day she left the Somnoire, Lucy stopped at the threshold of the gateway and turned to Rover. Took one last look at the silent Moon beyond.
 
"That's not what they would've wanted, is it?"

voices.title: Thoughts: I
voices.content: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

voices.title: Thoughts: II
voices.content: ...Askin' about my cyberware? Guess you're not sportin' a scanner. Sorry, but I ain't interested in talking about me or my specs... Rather change the subject.

voices.title: Thoughts: III
voices.content: I fell into the edgerunner life by chance, but got the gist of crew dynamics pretty quick. Us havin' two netrunners proved a real advantage. When things got messy, I could hand off hacking duties and flank the enemy with my monowire... Adaptive and effective.

voices.title: Thoughts: IV
voices.content: Ahem... So yeah, should apologize for tryin' to hack you. If it's any comfort, I got zilch. My scans couldn't read your biodata—your identity's a total black box. Piqued my curiosity, sure, but I decided against digging. Who you are now... is someone I trust.

voices.title: Thoughts: V
voices.content: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

voices.title: Lucy's Hobby
voices.content: I used to slip outside city limits on still nights to go see the stars. The peace, the silence... I could let my worries melt away, y'know? From the desert, Night City looks like a neon prison, a cage of light. And everyone's trapped inside... myself included.

voices.title: Lucy's Trouble
voices.content: Sleep doesn't come easily. I close my eyes, and he's there... the cyborg boogeyman. My memory of that day follows me everywhere, even to the Moon. But after what happened here, think I feel strong enough now to face it. So... thank you.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.content: Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.

voices.title: Disliked Food
voices.content: Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

voices.title: Ideals
voices.content: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

voices.title: Chat: I
voices.content: "The David Martinez"—it's a cocktail found at a bar in Night City called The Afterlife. Vodka, ice and a splash of NiCola. It's funny... David never liked fizzy drinks... For most, that drink honors a merc legend. For me... a man my heart will never forget.

voices.title: Chat: II
voices.content: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

voices.title: About Rebecca
voices.content: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

voices.title: About Mornye
voices.content: "Tragedy did not extinguish her ideals. She works tirelessly to reach the stars with her own two hands." I mean, sh*t, you can feel the weight of these records just by reading them. If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.

voices.title: About Lynae
voices.content: When my Resonance Ability awakened, I hacked Lynae. Not on purpose, but I did see the memories she'd locked away. Hard to reconcile the weight of her past with that big, bright smile. Can't say we're all that different, her and I. I'm just glad she's finally free.

voices.title: About Lucilla
voices.content: We've never crossed paths, but her rep's solid. Hear she did a lot of heavy lifting with the Somnoire situation. The approachable Madam President, former editor for the Pioneer Association... Official file reads like a press release though. Bet the real story's a helluva lot more interesting. Wouldn't mind a face-to-face, see the woman behind the curtain.

voices.title: About Sigrika
voices.content: Sigrika is an interesting girl. Has a way of puttin' people at ease. But what gets me are the runes she uses. What are they? They seem to follow a unique operational logic... some kind of unparsed assembly language? What's the transmission method...?

voices.title: Birthday Wishes
voices.content: When I hacked into the Second Coming of Solaris's database, I found a sealed file with your birth date. Sooo... surprise, happy birthday. Rebecca's been on my case for weeks 'bout a party. Whenever you're ready, I'll take you there.

voices.title: Idle: I
voices.content: Hm? Buried payload. Someone left a present.

voices.title: Idle: III
voices.content: Yeah, could use a little unwind.

voices.title: Idle: IV
voices.content: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

voices.title: Idle: V
voices.content: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

voices.title: Idle: VI
voices.content: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

voices.title: Idle: VII
voices.content: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

voices.title: Self-Introduction
voices.content: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

voices.title: Greeting
voices.content: I know... the dream had to end.

voices.title: Ascension: I
voices.content: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

voices.title: Ascension: II
voices.content: Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?

voices.title: Ascension: III
voices.content: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

voices.title: Ascension: IV
voices.content: Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.

voices.title: Ascension: V
voices.content: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: I
voices.content: Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

goods.title: Moon Travel Poster
goods.content:
A poster advertising trips to the Moon. There was a time you couldn't walk a block in Night City without seeing a travel promotion. In these ads, it was sold as an untouched paradise. Clean, free from the rot of corporate greed. A place where everyone lived equally. Without worry, without care. But the price tag was steep. The facilities were a joke. Word spread that it was just another corporate scam. And like all of them, it faded from the conversation.

Now, dreamers dismiss it as just another corporate con. But there's still one girl standing on a rooftop, looking up, hoping that one day she might escape to the Moon.

goods.title: Braindance Wreath
goods.content:
Braindance is the most popular form of immersive media in Night City—a technology that records and replays memories and experiences. For many, it is an escape from reality; a place to sink into illusory lives that feel better than anything the real world can offer. 

For Lucy, it is a lifeline. She has a braindance of a trip to the Moon, and it is one of her most treasured possessions. Late at night, alone in her apartment, she jacks in and lets the digital reality take her far away. She savors the tranquility, imagining a future where this dream finally comes true.

goods.title: Tarot Card
goods.content:
The Moon Tarot Card. It symbolizes fear, the subconscious, illusions, and truths waiting to be discovered. In the illustration, one wolf howls at the distant, unreachable moon. The other waits in silence, its gaze fixed on the first.
 
The card was a gift from Misty, who gave her a tarot reading. Lucy took it with her to the Moon—one of the few pieces of Night City she brought up there. It held a strong meaning to her. Almost magical.

skill.name: Netrunner
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color></size>
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for {0}s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to {1} different <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is held down, <color=Highlight>Override</color> is triggered, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any <color=Highlight>Spoofing Programs</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to trigger <color=Highlight>Override</color> on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Ping</color>
Requires {3} RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>
Requires {4} RAM. Marked targets take {5}% more DMG for {6}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>
Requires {7} RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by {8}% for {9}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout</color>
Requires {10} RAM. Deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>
Requires {11} RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by {12}% for {13}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>
Requires {14} RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by {15}% within {16}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>
Requires {17} RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>. Lucy gains all effects of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>, and the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Override</color> is greatly increased.
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or when Lucy exits the <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
skill.simple_desc:

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>. Lucy gains all effects of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>, and deals increased <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

skill.name: Ghost Cyberware
skill.desc:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for {0}s, she gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. Max <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} by default.
<color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by {3}%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. This effect can be triggered up to <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every {5}s.
skill.simple_desc: When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for a certain period of time, she takes {0}% less DMG from the next incoming attack and triggers a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.

skill.name: Function Cracking
skill.desc:
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> damages an <color=Highlight>Overlord Class</color> or <color=Highlight>Calamity Class</color> enemy, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> on them for {0} min. While <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Network Backdoor</color></size>
Grants {1}% All DMG Amplification and {2}% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for {3} min and stacks up to {4} times. At {5} stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by {6}% and Hack DMG Multiplier by {7}%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color>, and any existing <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effects become invalid.
skill.simple_desc: When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> damages an <color=Highlight>Overlord Class</color> or <color=Highlight>Calamity Class</color> enemy, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color>. When a Resonator in the team defeats the target by dealing DMG while the mark is active, Lucy gains All DMG Amplification and increased Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect can stack. If Rebecca is in the team, she also gains this effect.

skill.name: Outdated Hallucination
skill.desc:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and granting Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color>, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for {0}s. Additionally, <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color> is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for {1}s.
If Lucy is not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {2}</color>.
If Lucy is in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {3}</color>.
After casting this skill, the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color>.
skill.simple_desc:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and granting all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color>, which allows them to see targets behind obstacles. This effect is enhanced on Rebecca. If Rebecca's <color=Highlight>turret</color> is on the field, it gains Overload, increasing its DMG.
After casting this skill, the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> grants additional <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.

skill.name: Depths of Blackwall
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Cloud Portal</color></size>
When not in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> upon hitting a target. At {0} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> clears all <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Algorithm Compaction</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> and gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Lucy's <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> is increased by {2}% for {3}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> again will not grant <color=Highlight>SQL</color> and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> upon hitting a target with attacks including <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Reaching {4} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by {5}% and remove <color=Highlight>SQL</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy does not have <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, she loses {6}% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below {7}%, no HP is consumed.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.
Lucy exits the the <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> state after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is not followed up by one of these skills: <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Locked Thread</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, and <color=Highlight>Tune Break - Data Crash</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hack Response - Data Crash</color></size>
Lucy deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> and applies the same target with <color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>, considered Hack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for {9}s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>TCP</color></size>
Lucy holds up to {10} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, casting the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants <SapTag=A>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Root Access</color></size>
Lucy holds up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Cloud Portal</color></size>
When not in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains Forte Gauge <color=Highlight>TCP</color> upon hitting a target. At full <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Algorithm Compaction</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> and gains <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Lucy's <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> is increased.
When in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains Forte Gauge <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> when attacks including <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> land. At full <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>,  <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color> to chain into <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hack Response - Data Crash</color></size>
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to targets affected by <color=Highlight>Hack - Interfered</color> and inflict <color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Hack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

skill.name: Countermeasure Program
skill.desc:
The incoming Resonator gains {0}% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for {1}s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> for {2}s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, that Resonator gains {3}% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them {5}% DMG Reduction for {4}s and Stagnates their attacker for {6}s. This effect can only trigger up to {7} time while <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> is active. Obtaining <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> again resets the effective charge. 
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> early.
skill.simple_desc:
The incoming Resonator gains Basic Attack DMG Amplification.
When the active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts <color=Highlight>Hack - Shifting</color>, the Resonator gains All DMG Amplification. When Resonators in the team other than Lucy take damage, Lucy grants them DMG Reduction and Stagnates their attacker.
When the All DMG Amplification effect is active, switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> early.

skill.name: Data Crash
skill.desc:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lucy can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1} every {0}s.
skill.simple_desc:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lucy can cast <color=Highlight>Tune Break</color> on the target.
Responding to <color=Highlight>Hack - Interfered</color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight>Tune Break</color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight>Hack - Interfered</color>, Lucy casts <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color>. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1} every {0}s.

1.name: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
1.desc:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color> increases ATK by {0}% for {1}s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding <color=Highlight>Quick Action</color> on that Resonator for {2}s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
<color=Highlight>Quick Action</color>: When activated, inflict the recorded <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects can be recorded: <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>, and <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>. When applying <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects via <color=Highlight>Quick Action</color>, only the continuous status effects are applied.

2.name: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
2.desc:
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, Lucy's starting <color=Highlight>RAM</color> is increased to {0}.
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>, deal <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> additional {Cus:Sap,S=instance P=instances SapTag=1} of <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> equal to {2}% of Lucy's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When this instance of damage hits the target, apply all of the following <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects: <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>, 
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>, and <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>. Only the continuous status effects are applied.
<color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Depths of Blackwall</color> is enhanced: When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight><te href=151106>SQL</te></color>, the DMG Multiplier increase is raised from {3}% to {4}%.

3.name: Cyberpunk
3.desc:
The DMG Multiplier of Override from <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is increased by {0}%, and its Crit. DMG is increased by {1}%.
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color> is increased by {2}%.
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> is increased by {3}%.

4.name: No Living Legends in Night City
4.desc: When Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, Resonators in the team gain {0}% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for {1}s.

5.name: A Broken Path to Hell
5.desc:
The stack limit of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> obtainable via <color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware</color> is increased to {0}.
<color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware</color> is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below {1}%, she immediately gains <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of {3}s. When <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to {4}% of ATK for {5}s.

6.name: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
6.desc:
Targets with <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> or in the <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> state take {0}% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
Targets with <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> or in the <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> state take {1}% increased Hack DMG from Lucy.
The Stagnation triggered by <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> now lasts for {2}s.

81001511.name: Lucy
81001511.bg_description:
Lucy's everyday outfit. Lightweight, stylish, and street-ready—it checks every box for a netrunner on a gig. 
Since it works for the job, she sees no reason to bother changing.

features: Deal powerful Heavy Attack DMG and Hack DMG.
Casting Resonance Liberation enables Lucy to hack into the target, inflicting various <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects.
Outro Skill grants other Resonators in the team DMG Reduction and the next incoming Resonator <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG Amplification</color>.

151104.desc:
Hitting a target recovers <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> grants buffs and recovers <color=Highlight>TCP</color> per second.
At max <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>. After casting this skill, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>.

151105.desc:
Entering <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> enhances Lucy's Normal Attacks, and grants <color=Highlight>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> and a stack of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>.
Hitting a target recovers <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>. At max <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold the Normal Attack button within a short period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.

151106.desc:
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> with <color=Highlight>SQL</color> greatly increases the DMG dealt. After casting this skill, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, which deals DMG with a higher DMG Multiplier.
